message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible vulnerabilities newly reported in the last 24 hours were confirmed as relevant to the assigned DLL/component inventory.

**Scope**

- Source: `DLL_software_component.txt` only; repeated component names and obvious aliases were normalized and deduplicated.
- `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined with this scan.
- Window: 2026-09-20 13:10 IST through 2026-09-21 13:10 IST (2026-09-20 07:40 UTC through 2026-09-21 07:40 UTC).

**Findings**

No in-window candidate passed the freshness, credible-source, and exact product-match checks. Newly published CVE records in the window affected unrelated products. Vendor and ecosystem checks for the monitored .NET/NuGet, JavaScript, document/PDF, identity, data-access, UI, and commercial SDK components did not confirm a relevant new disclosure.

**MongoDB ecosystem verification**

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries. The newest entries on MongoDB's official alerts page were dated September 17, outside this run's window; no in-window MongoDB finding was confirmed.

Sources checked included the [MongoDB security alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [newly published CVE listings](https://www.tenable.com/cve/newest), NVD/CVE-indexed records, vendor advisories, GitHub security advisories, CISA sources, and credible security reporting.

**Review priority**

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this monitoring window. Continue routine monitoring; this result does not assess older known vulnerabilities that may already apply to the listed component versions.
